content: The Chronic Care Model (CCM) highlights the importance of a person-centered and team-based approach to healthcare. Within the framework of the CCM, the emphasis is placed on cultivating a proactive healthcare environment. This approach encourages patients to actively engage in the development and execution of their care plans. The model underscores the concept of shared responsibility and accountability for health outcomes. It empowers individuals with diabetes to take an active and informed role in managing their condition in partnership with their healthcare team. By fostering a supportive and collaborative environment, the CCM enables patients to establish and pursue personalized health goals. These goals are tailored to align with the patient’s unique lifestyle, preferences, and values, ensuring a more individualized and effective approach to diabetes management.
